info.name: GMCL API (Node.js migration)
info.description:
All migrated GMCL API endpoints (/api/*), same contract as the PHP API.

1. Set `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:3001).
2. `apiKey` is the static key the PHP API accepted in the Authorization header.
3. Run "1. User → login" first: it stores `{{token}}`, used by the Member and Cart folders.

Every route accepts any HTTP verb, as CodeIgniter did; GET is used for read-only calls and POST (form fields) where the PHP code reads POST data. Optional filters are included but disabled — enable them as needed. Tests assert the status and `success` value the PHP API returned for the same request.
